Your "Total Balance" is divided into "Deposit Balance" and "Withdrawable Balance".  You can use the money in your "Total Balance" to play games anytime! 

① Deposit Balance: It includes the money you deposit and you receive from Promotions. 
② Withdrawable Balance: It includes a part of the money you win in Cash Games and Tournaments.

For example: If your "Deposit Balance" is ₹100 and your "Withdrawable Balance" is ₹400, then your Total Balance is ₹500 and you have ₹500 to play games!
